candidates.title: Poster: NeuroCERT: Executable Testing for Oracle-Limited Biophysical Network Simulation
candidates.authors: Seungyoun Lee, Hyun Jae Jang, Jae-Ho Han
candidates.venue: 2026 IEEE International Conference on Software Testing, Verification and Validation (ICST), pp. 324-327
candidates.found_via: Semantic Scholar Graph API search 'reproducibility regression testing computational neuroscience' (paper 0df3dfa91a49c5aa53ef266836f49fe824257f9f); metadata verified via Crossref api.crossref.org/works/10.1109/ICST69053.2026.00050; also Google Scholar 'NeuroCERT neurosimulation regression traceability' (IEEE Xplore page https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/11600512/)
candidates.why_relevant: Neuroscience-specific executable regression-testing layer for stochastic biophysical network simulations: records run provenance, checks pre-run structural constraints and applies batch-level stochastic regression criteria without changing the model (per S2 abstract). Closest found work on regression testing of neuroscience simulations in a software-testing venue; differs from NeuroSem by network-level stochastic outputs, no controlled mutation families, no multi-protocol current-clamp fingerprints, no protocol-battery selection or held-out evaluation. Short poster paper; full text not retrieved.
